actions.action: Check roots by easing plant out of pot if still limp after 10-14 days
Check whether old soil is water-repellent (pot weight after watering, poke soil)
Bottom-soak pot for 20-30 minutes and drain
Water when top inch is dry, about every 7-10 days
Repot into fresh potting soil/orchid bark or perlite mix in pot with drainage, removing old soil and trimming dead roots
Take 3-5 insurance cuttings, let dry a day, and plant in barely moist mix

reason: The answer names prolonged drought and old compacted soil as the main cause, and its watering-plus-repotting advice matches what fixed the plant, with nothing harmful.
